I posted the ticket list in #strategic-pod as a reply to your message. The list has five tickets, each with its source:

1. #8841, gate kiosk timeout at Allentown (Door 12). Sources: #strategic-pod on 2026-07-01 (Gideon says he closed it), digest 2026-05-04 (still open), and digest 2026-09-30 (Mateo's report of a Newark Door 14 kiosk problem, escalated to platform engineering). The later digests describe it differently from the July message, so its current status needs checking.
2. PD-8841, two missed carrier check-ins at Allentown Gate 4. Source: digest 2026-04-27 only. It may be the same issue as #8841, but the files don't confirm that.
3. PD-4418, Carrier_Dwell_Summary export dropping timestamps at Door 9. Source: digest 2025-09-15, which says only "the account Nadia runs". The Vantorre Group attribution is unconfirmed.
4. INC-4821, Hartford kiosk outage (status-page access, screenshot). Source: #inc-vtg-hartford on 2026-08-03.
5. VT-55120, root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage. Source: #inc-vtg-hartford on 2026-10-14.

I left out #4812 (Vantorre Mobility) and PD-4402 (Quillfeather Outfitters). The Hartford thread doesn't say whether INC-4821 and VT-55120 are linked, and I didn't open the attachments on VT-55120.
